Maria_eGFR.plain_language: Maria, your eGFR — a measure of how well your kidneys are filtering waste — has been slowly declining over the past 18 months. Maria_Creatinine.plain_language: Maria, your creatinine level has been rising steadily and has now crossed above the normal range. Creatinine is a waste product your kidneys normally filter out, so rising levels can mean your kidneys are working less efficiently. This is worth discussing with your doctor — not an emergency, but something to address proactively.
